sheet_metal_info.description: [mm/deg/kg] Sheet-metal data: thickness_mm, bend_radius_mm, K-factor / bend table, bends, material and SW's cut-list properties (flat bounding box, cutting length…). Active part; one assembly component; or — for an assembly — EVERY sheet-metal part (deduped by file+config, with qty) and a by_thickness summary. details=True includes cut-list properties per part.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

export_flat_dxf.description: [mm/deg/kg] Flat-pattern DXF straight from the model (no drawing). Active sheet-metal part → file_path (default next to the part); one assembly component; or the WHOLE active assembly → one DXF per unique part+configuration in out_dir (default <assembly folder>\DXF) named <name>[_<config>]_<t>mm_x<qty>.dxf, <name> = file name, or «Обозначение» (name_by=designation) / «Обозначение Наименование». layers=True sorts the geometry onto layers for laser CAM: CUT_OUTER (white), CUT_INNER (red), BEND (green, dashed), MARK (blue — open sketch chains); skipped with hidden_edges / bounding_box. note=True writes «designation | t | qty | material» under the part on layer NOTE (not a cut layer). Every file entry carries designation, thickness, bend radius, K, material, qty.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

view_image.description: [mm/deg/kg] SEE the model: PNG of the active document returned as an image. view: front/back/left/right/top/ bottom/iso/trimetric/dimetric or '*<named view>'; ANY direction: view_dir = [x,y,z] from the model toward you ([1,1,1] = iso, [-1,1,-1] = iso from behind-left, [0,-1,0] = from below), up = the screen's up (default +Y). CLOSE-UP of a unit: focus = components to zoom to (isolate=True hides everything else), or focus_box_mm = [x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2] in model / assembly space — far better than a bigger picture of the whole machine (a unit covered by others from that side: isolate=True, or a section). size = the LONG side in px (≤2000; image tokens grow with the area); long narrow parts get it too. display shaded_edges (default; edges keep light parts visible), shaded, hlr, hlv, wireframe. Optional section through a plane (+offset), hidden components. The answer's view_axes say which model axis points right / up / toward you; triad draws them in a corner. render=True: a presentation picture — perspective, shadows, ambient occlusion, full-scene anti-aliasing, no edge lines (slower; for showing a design, not for checking it). Auto-cropped; saved to file_path or a temp file.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_status.description: [mm/deg/kg] SOLIDWORKS Simulation: add-in version and the active document's studies (type, mesh elements, loads+fixtures count, has_results, active). study / details=True add that study's setup: materials per body/shell, fixtures / loads / connectors, global contact and contact sets, mesh and mesh controls — check it before sim_run.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_create_study.description: [mm/deg/kg] Create a Simulation study on the active part/assembly and make it active (sheet metal is meshed as shells automatically). Workflow: create → sim_set_material (if parts lack a material) → sim_add_fixture → sim_add_load → [sim_contact] → sim_mesh → sim_run → sim_results.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_delete_study.description: [mm/deg/kg] Delete a Simulation study by name.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_set_material.description: [mm/deg/kg] Assign a library material (e.g. 'AISI 304', 'AISI 1020', 'Plain Carbon Steel', '1060 Alloy') to all solid bodies and shells of the study (or only `components`). Needed when RunAnalysis reports a missing material; parts with a SOLIDWORKS material already have it.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_add_fixture.description: [mm/deg/kg] Add a fixture (restraint) on faces of the active/named study. faces: list of {"face_index": i} (part, analyze_model(faces) numbering) | {"component": "X-1", "face_index": i} (assembly, analyze_assembly(faces, component)) | {"point_mm": [x,y,z]} (a point ON the face, found by geometry — a hidden hole wall too).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_add_load.description: [mm/deg/kg] Add a load. force: value N total over the faces, direction [x,y,z] GLOBAL (empty = normal to the face). pressure: value MPa normal to the faces (reverse flips). gravity: value m/s² (default 9.81), direction default [0,-1,0], no faces. SHEET METAL (shells): load the large sheet faces — loads on the thin thickness/side faces are not carried to the shell mid-surface (observed: zero result). faces: list of {"face_index": i} (part, analyze_model(faces) numbering) | {"component": "X-1", "face_index": i} (assembly, analyze_assembly(faces, component)) | {"point_mm": [x,y,z]} (a point ON the face, found by geometry — a hidden hole wall too).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_contact.description: [mm/deg/kg] Global contact between touching assembly components (bonded = welded/glued, SW default; no_penetration = parts may separate/slide).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_mesh.description: [mm/deg/kg] Mesh the study. element_size_mm 0 = SolidWorks default size. Returns elements/nodes/time.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_run.description: [mm/deg/kg] Solve the study (blocks until done; mesh first) and return the results summary like sim_results.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_results.description: [mm/deg/kg] Results of a solved study. Static: von Mises min/max MPa and displacement min/max mm, each with the node and max_at_mm location, factor of safety (automatic; for sheet-metal shells = lowest yield of the study materials / max σ; yield_mpa overrides), connector forces and edge-weld pass/fail. When the von Mises max sits on a fixture or a loaded face: von_mises_mpa.max_on names it and max_away_from_boundary is the highest stress farther than two elements from every fixture and load — judge the part by that, not by the max (peak_note says why). Frequency: resonant frequencies (Hz). Buckling: load factors.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_plot.description: [mm/deg/kg] Create and activate a result plot in the study (for viewing in SolidWorks) and return its min/max. To SEE the result use sim_image.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

dimension_for_face.description: [mm/deg/kg] Find the driving dimension behind ONE face of the active part — the step between a face that is off (face_index) and modify_dimension. Walks feature_map to the feature that CREATED the face, takes that feature's profile sketch, finds the sketch segment the face was swept from (a cylinder -> the circle/arc with the same radius on its axis; a side wall -> the line lying in its plane; a cap parallel to the sketch -> the extrude's depth), and returns the dimension SolidWorks reports as ATTACHED to that segment. face_index: from analyze_model(faces) (or compare_parts' face diff). add_if_missing: when the segment has no driving dimension, add one at the segment's CURRENT size (geometry unchanged) and return its name (status 'added'). Returns JSON: status ('dimensioned' | 'undimensioned' | 'added' | 'not_dimension_driven' | 'multiple_dimensions' | 'ambiguous_feature' | 'ambiguous_segment' | 'unattributed' | 'no_segment' | 'no_profile_sketch' | 'unsupported'), feature, sketch, segment (sketch frame), dimension {name (pass to modify_dimension), value_mm | value_deg, type}, position_dimensions for a circle (lengths in mm). Anything that does not resolve to exactly one candidate is reported, never guessed. Read-only unless add_if_missing adds a dimension. feature_map rebuilds the tree step by step, so this takes a few seconds on large parts.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

list_mates.description: [mm/deg/kg] Mates of the ACTIVE assembly (incl. mate folders): name, type, alignment, value_mm / value_deg, components, suppressed, and error (over-defined / unsatisfied). Filter by component substring or errors_only. Lighter than analyze_assembly(mates).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

edit_mate.description: [mm/deg/kg] Edit an existing mate by name: value_mm (distance) / value_deg (angle), flip alignment, suppress / unsuppress, rename, re-point it at other geometry (entities: new entity specs, same count/kinds), or delete. Returns the mate's new state incl. any error. Entity spec: {"component","face_index"} | {"component","edge_index"} (indices from analyze_assembly(faces|edges, component)) | {"plane": "Top Plane"} (assembly plane, any language) | {"component","plane"} | {"component"}.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

constraint_status.description: [mm/deg/kg] Per component of the ACTIVE assembly: fixed / fully_defined / under_defined / over_defined and its mate count, plus a summary and the number of mates with errors. problems_only hides fixed/fully.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sheet_metal_cutlist.description: [mm/deg/kg] Cutting / bending sheet for production. Active part or WHOLE assembly (unique part+config, qty × assembly_qty): Обозначение, Наименование, material, thickness, flat blank L×W mm, net area m², cut length mm, cut-outs, bends, bend radius, K, mass kg; totals per thickness+material (area, cut length, bends, mass). csv_path → ';'-CSV (Excel, RU decimals). xlsx_path → formatted Excel workbook: groups by thickness+material, positions sorted by «Обозначение» (same designation + blank merged, qty summed), totals as formulas, sheet «Итоги».

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sheet_metal_hem.description: [mm/deg/kg] Hem (подгибка) on edges of the ACTIVE sheet-metal part. edge_indices from analyze_model(edges) — the outer edges of the sheet face. closed/open use length+gap, tear_drop angle+radius, rolled angle+radius.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sheet_metal_miter_flange.description: [mm/deg/kg] Miter flange (кромка под углом) along a chain of edges (corners mitred automatically). Profile = `sketch` or the ACTIVE sketch: an open line/arc chain starting AT the end point of the first edge, on a plane normal to that edge (e.g. Right Plane for an edge along X ending at x=0). edge_indices from analyze_model(edges). radius_mm 0 = sheet default. Verified: L-profile along 2 edges -> 4 bends.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sheet_metal_cross_break.description: [mm/deg/kg] Cross break (поперечный перегиб, stiffening X) on faces of the ACTIVE sheet-metal part. Tip: corner fillet/chamfer of a sheet = add_edge_feature on the thickness edges.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

convert_to_sheet_metal.description: [mm/deg/kg] Convert a SOLID (e.g. a box modelled as a block) into sheet metal: fixed face + bend edges (corner rips are made automatically), thickness and bend radius. Indices from analyze_model(faces/edges). Example: box → open tray = fixed bottom face, bend edges = the 4 bottom edges. auto=True for a FLAT plate without bends: the largest planar face is fixed and the thickness is measured (its distance to the facing face); the side is checked by volume. Missing thickness_mm is measured the same way.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_image.description: [mm/deg/kg] SEE a solved study: colour map (blue→red) of von Mises stress (MPa) or displacement (mm) drawn from the solver's node data (solids and sheet-metal shells), with legend and the max marked. deform_scale: 0 = undeformed, -1 = auto, N = ×N. clip_percentile <100 (e.g. 99) caps the colour scale so a singular peak (fixture corner, point load) does not wash out the map; values above are red.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

add_plane_angle.description: [mm/deg/kg] Reference plane through an axis (by name) or an edge (analyze_model(edges) index) at angle_deg to base_plane (e.g. 'Front Plane'). The axis/edge must lie in or parallel to the base plane.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

add_axis_two_points.description: [mm/deg/kg] Reference axis through two model points [x,y,z] mm (made from a 3D-sketch line).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sweep_pipe.description: [mm/deg/kg] Pipe / hose / cable / rod along a 3D polyline (points [[x,y,z],…] mm) with a circular profile. wall_mm > 0 = tube; bend_radius_mm > 0 rounds the polyline corners (pipe bends).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

loft.description: [mm/deg/kg] Lofted boss through ≥2 closed profile sketches (names, in order, on different planes).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

set_body_visibility.description: [mm/deg/kg] Hide/show bodies of the active (multibody) part by name; empty list = all. Returns all body names.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

batch_export_files.description: [mm/deg/kg] Export many FILES (parts/assemblies/drawings by path) to a format (step, iges, stl, x_t, pdf, dxf…): each is opened read-only, saved as <out_dir or its folder>\<name>.<format>, closed. Errors per file.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

run_macro.description: [mm/deg/kg] Run a SolidWorks VBA macro (.swp / .swb) from the project's macros folder ONLY (SWMCP_MACROS_DIR, default <repo>\macros). module default '<file name>1'. args = {"name": value, …} → written to Environ("TEMP") & "\SolidWorksMCP\macro_args.txt" as "name=value" lines (CRLF, system code page — read them with Line Input and Split(line, "=")). A VBA error box is closed by the server and its text comes back in the error (MACRO_FAILED) or in dialogs_closed; VBA_BLOCKED = the VBA engine is stuck (ensure_ready).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

job_result.description: [mm/deg/kg] Result of a long operation that answered {"running": true, "job_id": …}. Waits up to wait_s (≤45) seconds; returns the result (with job_seconds), or the running answer again (then call job_result again).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

execute_batch.description: [mm/deg/kg] Run up to 100 tool calls in ONE request, in order: steps = [{"tool": "<name>", "args": {...}}, …] with exactly the arguments of the single tools — or steps_file = a JSON file on disk with that list (a long batch then never passes through the conversation). Reuse earlier results in string args: "$last.<path>" or "$<n>.<path>" (n = 0-based step) — a path into the step's answer, e.g. "$last.created.0" (the feature it made), "$1.study", "$0.components.0.name". report: full = {ok, steps, results: [{step, tool, …its answer | error}]}; summary = {ok, steps, failed: [{step, tool, error}], created, removed, saved, last}; auto = summary for a steps_file or more than 20 steps. Pictures of view_image / view_images steps come with the answer (up to 8). A tool of a group that is off runs here too: its group is turned on (`groups_turned_on`). Stops at the first error unless stop_on_error=False. If SolidWorks dies mid-batch it is restarted and the batch stops: `solidworks_restarted` says so — unsaved changes of the open documents are lost, `saved` lists what reached the disk.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

add_mate_advanced.description: [mm/deg/kg] Advanced / mechanical mates in the ACTIVE assembly: symmetric (entities ×2 + symmetry_plane) · width (width_entities ×2 + tab_entities ×2, constraint centered/ free/distance/percent) · profile_center (entities ×2 rectangular/circular faces, value_mm offset, lock_rotation) · hinge (concentric_entities ×2 + coincident_entities ×2) · gear (entities ×2 cylinders, ratio) · linear_coupler (entity1/entity2 + reference_component1/2, ratio) · lock (components ×2) · slot (entities). Entity spec: {"component","face_index"} | {"component","edge_index"} (indices from analyze_assembly(faces|edges, component)) | {"plane": "Top Plane"} (assembly plane, any language) | {"component","plane"} | {"component"}.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

insert_and_mate.description: [mm/deg/kg] Insert a part / sub-assembly into the ACTIVE assembly AND mate it in one call ("put it there"). mates: [{"type": coincident|concentric|parallel|perpendicular|tangent|distance|angle, "own": entity of the NEW component (face_index / edge_index / plane — no component), "target": existing entity spec, "alignment": closest|aligned|anti_aligned, "value_mm" | "value_deg"}]. All-or-nothing: if a mate fails the component is removed again. Returns component, origin_mm, mates, constraint status. Entity spec: {"component","face_index"} | {"component","edge_index"} (indices from analyze_assembly(faces|edges, component)) | {"plane": "Top Plane"} (assembly plane, any language) | {"component","plane"} | {"component"}.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

pattern_components.description: [mm/deg/kg] Pattern components of the ACTIVE assembly (local component pattern). linear: direction = a LINEAR EDGE or axis entity, count, spacing_mm (+ optional direction2/count2/spacing2_mm). circular: axis = axis / cylindrical face / circular edge entity, count, angle_deg (total with equal_spacing, else between instances). Entity spec: {"component","face_index"} | {"component","edge_index"} (indices from analyze_assembly(faces|edges, component)) | {"plane": "Top Plane"} (assembly plane, any language) | {"component","plane"} | {"component"}.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sheet_metal_gusset.description: [mm/deg/kg] Sheet-metal gusset (штампованное ребро жёсткости поперёк гиба) on the ACTIVE sheet-metal part. face_indices = the two flat faces on both sides of one bend (analyze_model(faces)). Position: along the bend edge (auto: the straight edge where face 1 meets the bend; or edge_index), offset_mm from its start (default: middle). Size: indent_depth_mm, or length_mm + height_mm (profile dimensions); width_mm = rib width, thickness_mm default = sheet thickness.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sheet_metal_dfm.description: [mm/deg/kg] Manufacturability (DFM) check of sheet metal: active part, one assembly component, or EVERY sheet-metal part of the active assembly. Flat patterns are read from the models (~1 s a part; one that cannot be is exported the old way) and analysed (t = thickness, R = bend radius): hole_to_bend — cut-out edge closer to a bend line than 2.5·t+R in the flat (0 = cut-out crosses the bend); hole_to_edge — cut-out closer to the outer contour than t; small_hole — Ø (or slot width) < t; short_flange — outside flange length (90° estimate) < 4·t; mixed_bend_radii — one part bent with several radii; cross_part radius_per_thickness — same thickness+material bent with different radii (extra tooling). Limits 0 = these defaults, any value in mm overrides. Issues carry flat-pattern coordinates `at` (mm); details=True adds every bend's flange lengths. keep_dxf_dir keeps the analysed flat patterns as DXF (for laser files use export_flat_dxf — SolidWorks' own export).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_connector.description: [mm/deg/kg] Connector in the study (assemblies of sheet metal: bolted / welded joints instead of global bonding). bolt: head = circular edge(s) (shells) or face(s) of the hole on the head side, nut = the same on the nut side (bolt_type nut) or the threaded hole (screw); diameter_mm shank, head_diameter_mm (default 1.6·d), preload_n axial. edge_weld: face1 + face2 (one face of each body) + edges where they meet; Eurocode 3 sizing with ultimate_mpa of the weaker part, βw, γM2; weld_size_mm 0 = SolidWorks estimates the size. pin: faces1/faces2 cylindrical faces of the two parts. After sim_run, sim_results lists connector forces and edge-weld pass/fail. Entity: {"face_index"} | {"edge_index"} (part) | {"component","face_index"|"edge_index"} (assembly, indices from analyze_assembly) | {"component"} | {"point_mm":[x,y,z]} (a point on a face).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_contact_set.description: [mm/deg/kg] Local contact pair between two entity sets (overrides the global contact for these faces): no_penetration (parts may separate/slide; friction = coefficient), bonded, free. delete = contact set name. Entity: {"face_index"} | {"edge_index"} (part) | {"component","face_index"|"edge_index"} (assembly, indices from analyze_assembly) | {"component"} | {"point_mm":[x,y,z]} (a point on a face).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_mesh_control.description: [mm/deg/kg] Local mesh refinement (сгущение сетки) on faces / edges / whole components: element_size_mm there, growth ratio away from them. Re-mesh afterwards (sim_mesh or sim_run). delete = mesh control name. Entity: {"face_index"} | {"edge_index"} (part) | {"component","face_index"|"edge_index"} (assembly, indices from analyze_assembly) | {"component"} | {"point_mm":[x,y,z]} (a point on a face).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_options.description: [mm/deg/kg] Static study options: adaptive h (refines the mesh until target_accuracy_pct, max_iterations loops) or p; large_displacement (big deflections of thin sheet); soft_spring / inertial_relief (stabilise a model with no full fixture); solver. Unset = unchanged; returns the current options.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_copy_study.description: [mm/deg/kg] Duplicate a study with its material, fixtures, loads, connectors and contacts (e.g. to try another load case or mesh) — the copy becomes active.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_report.description: [mm/deg/kg] Report of a SOLVED study into out_dir (default <model folder>\SimReport). engine=html (default): own HTML page — verdict against required_fos (from the stress away from fixtures and loads when the peak sits on one), results table (σ, displacement, FoS with locations), connector forces / weld checks, stress and displacement maps, materials, fixtures, loads, contacts, mesh. hand_checks: [{"title": "Шов плита–стенка", "check": "weld_check" | "bolt_check" | "beam_check", "args": {the tool's arguments}}] — computed here and listed with their inputs; a failed one fails the verdict. notes: the assumptions and where the loads come from, one line each. compare_studies: solved copies of the same case on other meshes (sim_copy_study + sim_mesh) → a mesh-sensitivity table; a governing stress that moves > 15 % is named a singularity and an "ok" then needs hand_checks. engine=solidworks: SOLIDWORKS' Word report — automates MS Word, which hung after the first report of a session on SW 2024 (then ~2 min and RPC fault); use only if the Word document is required.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

bolt_check.description: [mm/deg/kg] Hand check of one bolt (EN 1993-1-8 table 3.4): shear, tension, their interaction and — with plate_t_mm — bearing of the thinnest sheet (e1_mm = edge distance in the load direction). Feed it the shear_n / axial_n resultants of a bolt connector from sim_results. Returns resistances, utilizations, ok.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

weld_check.description: [mm/deg/kg] Hand check of a fillet weld (EN 1993-1-8 simplified method): f_vw,d = f_u/√3/(β_w·γ_M2), utilization = F/(f_vw,d·a·L·sides); a = throat_mm or 0.7·leg_mm. β_w 0.8 S235, 0.85 S275, 0.9 S355. Also returns the minimum throat for this force.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

beam_check.description: [mm/deg/kg] Hand check of a beam / bracket arm — an independent cross-check of an FEA result: section properties (rect b×h, rhs b×h×t, pipe d×t, round d, channel/U b×h×t, angle h×b×t; load along h), max moment, bending stress M/W, deflection (cantilever: point load at the end / UDL; simply_supported: mid-span / UDL), utilization vs f_y and span/deflection_limit.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

bom_gost.description: [mm/deg/kg] Specification (спецификация) of the ACTIVE assembly per GOST 2.106 form 1, one assembly level: sections Документация / Сборочные единицы / Детали / Стандартные изделия / Прочие изделия / Материалы / Комплекты from the «Раздел» property (else inferred: sub-assembly, part with «Обозначение», name citing ГОСТ/DIN/ISO → standard item, the rest → other items; «Детали» on a part without «Обозначение» that cites a standard or lies in a purchased-items folder is taken as a template default and inferred — moved_from_details lists them), positions through the sections, columns Формат / Зона / Поз. / Обозначение / Наименование / Кол. / Примечание (properties of the same names). assembly_drawing adds «<Обозначение> СБ Сборочный чертёж». xlsx_path → formatted Excel sheet.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

insert_bom_table.description: [mm/deg/kg] BOM table on the ACTIVE drawing for the assembly shown in `view` (default: the first assembly view): at the sheet's table anchor (anchor) or at x_mm/y_mm; template default = SolidWorks bom-standard. balloons=True adds auto-balloons to that view, numbered like the BOM. Returns header + first rows.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

weldment_profiles.description: [mm/deg/kg] Weldment profile library (Tools > Options > File Locations > Weldment Profiles): standards (iso, DIN, GOST …) → types → sizes. A size is either a .SLDLFP file in <standard>\<type>\ or a configuration of <standard>\<type>.SLDLFP (GOST folder). Use as weldment_member(profile='<standard>/<type>/<size>').

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

weldment_member.description: [mm/deg/kg] Structural members (сварная конструкция) in the ACTIVE part along sketch segments: profile '<standard>/<type>/<size>' (weldment_profiles) or a .SLDLFP path (+ size = configuration). One group = sketch (+ segments: indices among its non-construction segments, default all), angle_deg (profile rotation), corner treatment at group corners. Several groups: groups=[{sketch, segments, angle_deg, corner, mirror}]. Draw the layout first (create_sketch + lines; 3D frames: several sketches).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

weldment_cut_list.description: [mm/deg/kg] Weldment cut list (ведомость резки профиля) of the ACTIVE part: per item qty, description (profile size), length mm, end angles, material, mass; totals per profile (pieces, total length m). csv_path / xlsx_path write files; properties=True adds every cut-list property.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

weldment_trim.description: [mm/deg/kg] Trim / extend members (bodies by name, analyze_model(bodies)) to other members or to faces (by_faces: face indices). coped = coped cut, gap_mm = weld gap.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

weldment_end_cap.description: [mm/deg/kg] End caps (заглушки) on open member end faces (analyze_model(faces) indices); offset_mm = inset from the profile's outer edge, chamfer_mm = corner chamfer.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

weldment_gusset.description: [mm/deg/kg] Gusset (косынка) between two planar faces of members meeting at a corner: legs d1/d2 mm, thickness; polygon shape uses d3/d4 (chamfer).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

hole_wizard.description: [Port of Claw256 31deceb, METERS] Place a STANDARD SOLIDWORKS Hole Wizard hole (real counterbore / countersink / clearance / tapped hole with a thread callout) via IFeatureManager.HoleWizard5, at one or more points on a planar face. Target face: face_index (from analyze_model('faces')) OR a point face_x/face_y/face_z ON the face. points: array (or JSON string) of [x,y,z] METER hole centres lying ON that face, e.g. [[0.01,0.05,0]]. hole_type: counterbore | countersink | hole (clearance) | tap (tapped). standard: ansi_inch | ansi_metric | iso | din | jis. fastener_type: omit for the default of that standard + hole_type (ISO: tap 147, clearance 144, cap-screw cbore 139, flat-head csink 140; ANSI metric 43/40/33/35), or pass a swWzdHoleStandardFastenerTypes_e integer. A fastener or size that does not belong to the standard + hole_type FAILS (HOLE_WIZARD_FAILED). size: e.g. 'M6' (metric) or '1/4-20' / '#10-24' (inch tap). Metric tap pitch is added automatically (coarse 'M6' -> 'M6x1.0'; or give 'M6x1'); for non-tap holes a pitch is stripped. end_condition: blind (needs depth) | through_all. depth/diameter in METERS (diameter 0 = the standard's size); cbore_diameter/cbore_depth METERS; csink_diameter METERS and csink_angle DEGREES (included angle); thread_depth METERS (tap only). Ported from Claw256 31deceb (AGPL). Call it AFTER the body exists. On COMPLETED the result carries the created feature name and result_geometry.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

view_images.description: [mm/deg/kg] SEE the model from several sides in one call (default front/top/right/iso, like a drawing's view set): one image per view, returned together (up to 8). A view is a name ('top', '*Named') or an object with view_image's own parameters — {"view_dir": [-1,1,-1], "focus": [...]}, {"view": "front", "section_plane": "Right Plane", "file_path": "..."}. display / size / focus / isolate here are the defaults for every view. out_dir keeps the PNGs (default: temp).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

add_sketch_text.description: [mm/deg/kg] Text in the ACTIVE sketch (sketch coordinates, mm): part marking / engraving. Then cut it (extrude_feature cut, small depth) or keep the sketch and export it with the flat pattern (export_flat_dxf sketches=True → layer MARK for the laser).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

set_document_units.description: [mm/deg/kg] Units of the ACTIVE document (custom unit system): length unit, decimal places, angle unit.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

move_drawing_view.description: [mm/deg/kg] Move a view of the ACTIVE drawing to x_mm/y_mm on the sheet (view centre) and/or set its scale (0.5 = 1:2). Returns the new position.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

tool_help.description: [mm/deg/kg] Reference for this server: full description + parameters of any tool (topic = tool name), topic guides (start, units, assemblies, sheet_metal, simulation, weldments, drawings, reading_drawings, rules) or a search word. Empty topic = the guide list and every tool with one line, the tools of groups that are off too (they run through execute_batch). Descriptions ending with '[full: …]' were shortened.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sim_crosscheck.description: [mm/deg/kg] Independent check of a SOLVED static study with CalculiX on the SAME mesh: exports the mesh, builds a CalculiX deck (fixed = the study's fixed faces, loads = [{"faces": [...], "force_n": [fx, fy, fz]}] — the same as in sim_add_load), solves it with ccx and compares max displacement / von Mises with SolidWorks → evidence status pass / warn / blocked / failed (never a made-up number). Solid meshes (C3D4/C3D10) or sheet-metal shells (S6 with each shell's thickness — a draft mesh gets midside nodes, CalculiX's S3 locks in bending; nodal surface stress); a mesh mixing both, or pieces joined only by contacts, is blocked. ccx is found via SWMCP_CCX, PATH or PrePoMax / bConverged / FreeCAD folders; without it the deck is still written (status blocked). Entity specs as in sim_add_fixture.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

create_weldment_profiles.description: [mm/deg/kg] Weldment profiles the SolidWorks library lacks: GOST equal angles 8509-93 (20x20x3 … 100x100x8), channels 8240-97 series П (5П … 20П), seamless pipes 8732-78 (25x3 … 159x6) — one .SLDLFP per size in <out_dir>/GOST/<type>/ (default %USERPROFILE%/SolidWorksMCP/weldment profiles, searched by weldment_member). sizes = subset (e.g. ["40x40x4"], ["10П"]), default all. Section data = reference values — check them.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

import_step.description: [mm/deg/kg] A manufacturer's STEP / IGES (often a whole assembly) → ONE multibody .SLDPRT (default: next to the file, same name) — not an assembly with a file per component. Native bodies (3D Interconnect off), the imported document is closed without saving, the translator's .err log goes into the answer. Reports the bodies of the STEP vs the part (warning if fewer), surface bodies = pieces the translator could not knit into solids. inspect_only=True only reports what the file contains.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

import_step_folder.description: [mm/deg/kg] import_step for every STEP in a folder (sub-folders too): a .SLDPRT next to each file, existing ones are skipped unless overwrite. Long — answers {"running": true, "job_id": …}; job_result gives per-file results and totals.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

enable_tools.description: [mm/deg/kg] Turn on tool groups that are off (they stay on in the next sessions while you use them). Their tools appear in your tool list once your client re-reads it — some clients only in the next session; a tool of a group that is off always runs through execute_batch(steps=[{"tool": …, "args": …}]), which turns its group on by itself. Groups: sheet_metal, simulation, drawings (views, sections, dimensions, BOM table, reading a drawing), weldments (profiles, members, cut list), assemblies. tool_help('<tool>') says which group a tool is in and gives its parameters.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

form_subassembly.description: [mm/deg/kg] Move components of the ACTIVE assembly into a subassembly (SolidWorks' Form New Subassembly): a NEW .SLDASM at file_path, inserted at the parent's origin and fixed (coordinates do not change), or `into` an existing subassembly component. Positions are kept; mates among the moved components move along, mates to the rest stay in the parent. The components must sit on one level; a suppressed one is resolved for the move (reported). The subassembly file is saved, the parent is left modified — save_document keeps it. Answers subassembly, moved, max_shift_mm, mates_moved.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

define_sketch.description: [mm/deg/kg] Make a sketch FULLY DEFINED (black in SolidWorks) WITHOUT changing its shape, so its sizes can be edited (modify_dimension, a double-click in SolidWorks) and it rebuilds predictably. Three steps: 1. relations the geometry already satisfies exactly — shared end points coincident, lines along an axis horizontal / vertical, a point at the origin on it; 2. YOUR design dimensions at their current values — dimensions: [{px, py, entity_type?: 'segment'|'point', to_origin?, orientation?: 'auto'|'horizontal'|'vertical'}], picked like add_dimension (sketch frame, mm): the sizes a designer puts on the drawing (overall width and height, a hole's diameter and its position from an edge or the origin, a slot width); 3. auto=True: SolidWorks' Fully Define Sketch adds what is still missing (dimensions from the sketch origin, scheme baseline | chain | ordinate). A step that moves the geometry, over-defines the sketch or repeats a size is undone and listed in `skipped`. Call it once per sketch, after the shape is drawn and before the feature; on the open sketch, or sketch_name (opened and closed again). It never changes a size — add_dimension(value) / modify_dimension do. Answers status, free_segments (what is still blue), relations_added, dimensions_added, design_dimensions, max_shift_mm, skipped. A profile takes 1-6 s; a sketch of ~100 segments a minute or more (auto).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

delete_components.description: [mm/deg/kg] Delete components of the ACTIVE assembly in ONE operation (one selection, one rebuild — dozens in seconds; their mates go with them). names = exact names from list_components; prefix = every component whose full name starts with it ('Винт М6' at the top level, 'Sub-1/Винт' inside Sub-1). Answers deleted_count, deleted, not_deleted.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

sketch_modify.description: [mm/deg/kg] Change an EXISTING sketch in one call, then rebuild — instead of piling new features over a profile. In order: delete_all=True removes every segment (construction lines stay unless keep_construction=False) — a REPLACE when add_segments follows; delete_near = [[x, y], …] removes the segment passing each point; move_points = [[from_x, from_y, to_x, to_y], …] moves sketch points (a point held by a dimension or relation stays — reported in not_moved); add_segments = records exactly like add_sketch_entities. All in mm, SKETCH coordinates (analyze_model(sketch, name) shows them). Answers deleted / moved / added, sketch_status and features_with_errors (features that fail after the change — fix or delete them).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

unreferenced_files.description: [mm/deg/kg] Model files (.sldprt / .sldasm) under `folder` that none of the `roots` (top assemblies, full paths) uses — read from the files' references on disk, nothing is opened. exclude = path fragments to skip (e.g. a library folder). Also drawings_of_unreferenced: drawings whose models are all unused. Paths relative to folder.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

list_materials.description: [mm/deg/kg] Materials in SolidWorks' material databases: name, library, class. query = words that must all appear ("6061", "nylon", "aisi 304"). set_part_material takes the exact name (and its library).

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

layout_drawing_views.description: [mm/deg/kg] Arrange the views of the ACTIVE sheet: front view as the main one, the others in projection relation to it (first angle — GOST/ISO E: top view below, left view on the right; third angle — top above, right view on the right; auto = the sheet's own setting), lined up on the views' own points; isometric, sections, details and flat patterns in the free cells of that block, then a column on its right (a section's projection link is removed — it stands by its label). Each view's box counts its dimension texts and, for a labelled view, the label SolidWorks keeps above it (~28 mm). No overlaps, inside the frame (margins_mm [left, bottom, right, top], default GOST 2.301: 20, 5, 5, 5), clear of the title block (title_block_mm [w, h] in the bottom right corner, default 185 × 55) and of the sheet's own notes and signs (technical requirements, roughness). scale: "fit" = the largest standard scale (GOST 2.302) at which it all fits — set as the SHEET's scale (the title block shows it, the views use it); "keep"; or a ratio "1:2". Tables are not avoided. arrange (default True) sets the dimensions off the geometry again after a scale change (Auto Arrange). Returns each view's box, the scale and fits / overlaps.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

dedupe_drawing_dimensions.description: [mm/deg/kg] Remove repeated dimensions on the ACTIVE drawing: auto_dimension_drawing puts one model dimension into every view that can show it, while a drawing gives each size once. Each model dimension shown in several views is kept in the best one — front, top, left / right, section, detail, the rest; isometric last — and its copies are deleted from the drawing (the model is not touched). Also one size given twice in a view by two sketches (same kind, value and measured points — the profile's 170 and the holes' 170): the first stays. Dimensions made in the drawing are left alone. arrange (default True) closes up the stacks afterwards. dry_run lists what would go.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)

add_dimension_between.description: [mm/deg/kg] Drawing dimension BETWEEN two entities of one view (edge – edge, hole circle – edge, vertex – vertex …): a point ON each. With `view` the points (and text) are in that view's own frame, model mm — exactly the coordinates check_drawing(include_geometry) lists for its lines / circles; without it they are sheet mm. orientation horizontal / vertical measures along the sheet's X / Y; auto lets SolidWorks choose (parallel edges → their distance, two circles → centre distance). Text default: 12 mm above (right of, for vertical) the pair. Returns the value in mm (deg) and the sheet points used.

input.state_version: integer (required, must match current execution state)
